text: Elongation, over and over. The next transfer RNA enters the A site, its anticodon pairing with the codon. The ribosomal RNA joins the growing chain to the new amino acid with a peptide bond, and the ribosome moves on one codon. The empty transfer RNA leaves from the E site.
